title: Decimal Garden

serves.summary: The learner plants tenths and hundredths of a 100-square garden to show decimals such as 0.6 and 0.45, compares two planted gardens, and then compares and orders decimals without the gardens (0.3 is more than 0.29), which shows decimal place value and comparing decimals to hundredths.

request.objective: Show tenths and hundredths as parts of one whole and compare two decimals to hundredths by reasoning about their size, recognising that comparisons are valid only for the same whole (4.NF.C.5-7).

problems.goal: 60 of the 100 squares are planted (6 columns, or any 60 squares).
45 squares are planted: 4 columns and 5 more squares.

problems.ask: Plant each garden, then give the trophy to the bigger amount.
problems.goal: 0.5 and 0.45 are planted correctly and the trophy is on 0.5.

problems.ask: No gardens this time. Give the trophy to the bigger amount.
Tap the amounts from smallest to biggest.
